title: Badaaqa marih fanat qadli
intro: Inki muuci ummattak foocal sooleh, ken angaarawih addat qaadiinoo kee qadliino keenih seeca. Yallih taama abeyna ux qeedaalisso yaceenim kee qeedaalisso yaymaaqeenimih takkaawisa. ummatta ankacissam cinteh, ta num ken baaxok diiriyoonuh meysitak. ardi isih keenil cokmi ugtele. badaaqah fanat qadli soole ta muuci iyyaay?
clues: Anu tellemmoo kee tellemmol nagay culteh tan ummattah farmoytah ruubeenih sugen.
Yi ummatta ux qeedaalisso teceeh gersi marah uwwayti qilsa wak.
oson yoo meysisen baaxok yoo diiriye loonum anu diini ken seecak.
Anu farmoytit fanak kaxxam yabti raceena kinniyom kassitah.
Yi ummatta caylale ardi angoyyat yibbixeeh ken buxaaxil mano sinnim ken cabte.
Anu kilbatti hijaazal geytima madiyaan ummatta fan ruubem.

outcome.answer: Yi ummatta caylale ardi angoyyat yibbixen

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلْحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ
verse: They said, "O Shuʿayb, does your prayer [i.e., religion] command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!" (11:87)
